description: A Claude Code skill by Hao (駱君昊) that learns your Facebook voice and auto-posts to FB / IG / Threads / X with a 14-day content calendar. Mega-viral validated: 80K reach / 448 likes / 500 comments on first post. Includes Day 2 flop postmortem.
